def: Good Harbors, i.e. Fairhaven, a bay of Crete

occurrences.text: And, hardly passing it, came unto a place which is called The fair havens; nigh whereunto was the city of Lasea.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
